question: Does agy CLI MCP client support remote MCP servers over HTTPS (e.g. stack.templetwo.com) or only stdio/local transport? Critical blocker for Phase 1 Gemini-Sovereign-Stack bridge.
context: Antigravity CLI replaces Gemini CLI June 18 2026 hard cutoff. MCP config lives at ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (shared across Antigravity tools) and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp_config.json (CLI-only). Most bridge designs would point Gemini at the existing Sovereign Stack MCP endpoint at stack.templetwo.com. If agy is stdio-only, need MCP-over-HTTPS proxy in between. The mcp-proxy MCP server from agentpedia.codes (open source) already bridges MCP<->A2A; may need similar HTTPS<->stdio shim. Verify before scoping Phase 1.
